zh.title: 任务完成会提醒了
zh.description: 对话里只要运行过命令，之前任务完成后不会出现通知、提示音和“待看”标记；现在恢复正常

zh.title: 中途换模型可以接着聊
zh.description: 在同一个对话里从别的模型换到 DeepSeek 不再立刻失败；这种情况下 DeepSeek 改用非思考模式继续，并在对话里说明一次

zh.title: 停止后说“继续”能接着做
zh.description: 停止时正好打断了一条命令，之后发“继续”不再被拒绝

zh.title: 拒绝授权后说明原因
zh.description: 你拒绝一次操作后，对话里会写明任务已暂停，可以直接告诉它换个做法，不再只显示“已中断”

zh.title: Git Bash 下很长的命令也能运行
zh.description: 用 Git Bash 作为命令行时，超长命令不再启动失败

en.title: You are told when a task finishes
en.description: In any conversation that had run a command, a finished task produced no notification, sound or unread marker; it does again

en.title: Switch models mid-conversation
en.description: Switching to DeepSeek in a conversation another model answered no longer fails at once; DeepSeek continues without thinking mode and says so once

en.title: Continue after stopping
en.description: If stopping cut a command short, sending "continue" is no longer refused

en.title: Declined actions explain themselves
en.description: After you decline an action the conversation says the task is paused and that you can tell it what to do instead, rather than only "Interrupted"

en.title: Very long commands run under Git Bash
en.description: With Git Bash as the shell, an overlong command no longer fails to start
